name: millwright-inspector-development-machine
description: Millwright-Inspector agentic workflow system — delegates coding to an AI 'millwright' while the human acts as 'inspector' who reviews generated specs, plans, implementations, and diagrams at each stage.

data_root.title: Workflow data root
data_root.description: Folder (relative to the project root) where workflow data lives: journal/, quest/, and workflow-stream/. Defaults to 'millwright-inspector'.

auto_clear.title: Clear at clear gates
auto_clear.description: Run /clear by itself when a clear gate ends a turn. In auto mode it also sends /mi-continue; in manual mode you type /mi-continue yourself. Turn off to type /clear yourself.
